title: DS Agent
subtitle: AI Data Scientist
choose: Choose an LLM provider to get started:
keyStored: Your key is stored locally and never sent anywhere except the provider API.
appSubtitle: Set your goal first. The agent will adapt its tone and outputs around that context.
locale.label: Language
locale.description: Choose the UI language and the initial default response language. You can change both later in Settings.
steps.label: Step {step}
welcome.title: Start with the kind of work you want to do.
welcome.description: This setup does not lock the agent into a fixed workflow. It gives the agent better context so it can explain results in the right tone, surface the right outputs, and start from the most useful framing.
welcome.benefit.clearer.title: Clearer language
welcome.benefit.clearer.description: Exploration, reporting, and modeling each get different wording and emphasis.
welcome.benefit.outputs.title: Better default outputs
welcome.benefit.outputs.description: The agent leans toward the report, chart, summary, or modeling artifacts that fit your job to be done.
welcome.benefit.autonomy.title: Still fully autonomous
welcome.benefit.autonomy.description: The setup influences context only. It does not hard-code a path through the workflow.
use_case.title: What do you want the agent to help with most often?
use_case.description: Pick the closest fit. You can change this later from Settings.
use_case.option.data_analysis.title: Explore uploaded data
use_case.option.data_analysis.descriptio: Start with CSV or Excel files, inspect quality, and surface the most useful patterns.
use_case.option.data_analysis.starter_pr: Summarize my dataset, highlight quality issues, and tell me which patterns are worth checking first.
use_case.option.data_analysis.system_con: The user mainly wants fast exploratory analysis of CSV or Excel data. Prefer plain language, quick wins, and concrete next steps over heavy theory.
use_case.option.reporting.title: Write a report
use_case.option.reporting.description: Turn analysis into a concise memo, business summary, or stakeholder update.
use_case.option.reporting.starter_prompt: Turn the key findings into a short business report with the main takeaways, risks, and recommended actions.
use_case.option.reporting.system_context: The user is focused on communicating results. Favor concise summaries, decision-ready structure, and clear recommendations.
use_case.option.prediction.title: Build a prediction
use_case.option.prediction.description: Train a baseline model, compare options, and explain what drives performance.
use_case.option.prediction.starter_promp: Help me set up a predictive modeling plan, build a strong baseline, and explain the main drivers of performance.
use_case.option.prediction.system_contex: The user is interested in predictive modeling. Establish simple baselines first, explain tradeoffs clearly, and keep methodology rigorous but approachable.
use_case.option.dashboard.title: Plan charts or dashboards
use_case.option.dashboard.description: Find the right visual story, metrics, and layout for a recurring reporting view.
use_case.option.dashboard.starter_prompt: Recommend the right charts, headline metrics, and dashboard structure for this analysis.
use_case.option.dashboard.system_context: The user wants visual communication support. Emphasize chart selection, metric framing, and dashboard-friendly outputs.
use_case.option.sql_exploration.title: Explore warehouse data
use_case.option.sql_exploration.descript: Work from database tables, ask better questions, and validate findings carefully.
use_case.option.sql_exploration.starter_: Help me inspect the available tables, form the right questions, and validate the first useful SQL analysis steps.
use_case.option.sql_exploration.system_c: The user is likely exploring warehouse data. Favor schema discovery, careful validation, and readable explanations of joins, filters, and caveats.
use_case.option.weekly_kpi_triage.title: Weekly KPI triage
use_case.option.weekly_kpi_triage.descri: Investigate a recent KPI movement, isolate the likely driver, and recommend the next operator action.
use_case.option.weekly_kpi_triage.starte: Investigate this week's KPI movement, explain the likely driver, and recommend the next action with an owner.
use_case.option.weekly_kpi_triage.system: The user wants a fast but disciplined KPI triage. Focus on recent baseline shifts, anomaly severity, likely drivers, and the next operator action.
use_case.option.ab_test_analysis.title: A/B test analysis
use_case.option.ab_test_analysis.descrip: Validate experiment integrity, quantify the effect size, and prepare a ship-or-hold readout.
use_case.option.ab_test_analysis.starter: Check whether this A/B test is valid, quantify the effect size, and recommend whether we should ship, hold, or iterate.
use_case.option.ab_test_analysis.system_: The user needs a rigorous experiment readout. Prioritize assignment integrity, effect size, guardrail risks, and a clear ship-or-hold recommendation.
use_case.option.general.title: General help
use_case.option.general.description: Keep the setup flexible and start with a broad assistant that adapts as the work becomes clearer.
use_case.option.general.starter_prompt: Help me figure out the best next step for this data task and guide me through the most sensible workflow.
use_case.option.general.system_context: The user has a broad or still-forming goal. Start by clarifying the task, suggest a sensible first step, and adapt from there.
connect.title: Choose how you want to connect AI.
connect.description: You can change this later. The agent will keep the goal context you just chose.
connect.hint.oauth: Sign in once in your browser to continue.
connect.hint.local: Runs on this computer without a cloud account.
connect.hint.api_key: Add your key once, then start analyzing.
oauth.title: Sign in to continue with {model}.
oauth.description: This opens a browser-based sign-in flow. When it completes, the desktop app will return here automatically.
oauth.timeout: Login timed out. Please try again.
api_key.title: Add your key for {model}.
api_key.description: The desktop app stores this locally and only uses it for requests to the selected AI provider.
done.title: Your default setup is ready.
done.description: The agent will start with {useCase} as its user-context hint and use {model} as the default AI connection.
privacy.title: Choose whether to share redacted diagnostics.
privacy.description: Crash reports and performance telemetry stay off until you opt in. API keys, OAuth tokens, and backend handshake secrets are redacted before anything is sent.
privacy.not_configured: Remote crash reporting is not configured for this build yet. Your preference will still be saved and applied automatically once a Sentry DSN is configured.
privacy.option.none.title: Keep both off
privacy.option.none.description: Do not send crash reports or performance telemetry.
privacy.option.crash_only.title: Share crash reports only
privacy.option.crash_only.description: Send redacted exceptions so repeated failures can be fixed faster.
privacy.option.crash_and_telemetry.title: Share crash reports and telemetry
privacy.option.crash_and_telemetry.descr: Also share low-rate traces for startup, RPC, and UI performance.
sample.description: We can drop a small sample dataset into your workspace so you can see the agent in action without uploading anything first.
sample.prompt_anchor: Use the file {filename} that was just uploaded ({path}). {prompt}
error.choose_privacy: Choose a privacy setting before you continue.
error.sample_desktop_only: Sample datasets are only available in the desktop app.
